import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] f = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int k = (n + 1) / 2;
        Arrays.sort(f, 1, n + 1);
        System.out.println(f[k]);
    }
}
